findings.description: At 360px wide the expenses table is cut off: the Amount and Actions columns (and Edit/Delete) are off-screen with no visible indication, so amounts are not readable without hidden horizontal scroll.
Amount column is misaligned: header is right-aligned but the values are not aligned to it or to each other's decimal points (e.g. $124.00 sticks out past $42.50).

notes: Only brief listing pages checked; forms and keyboard a11y not tested.

cost.notes: estimate from 15491 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0031-$0.0372
